newsitem.title: UK: Nikko Europe makes appointments, combines research.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Europe makes appointments, combines research.

text.p: Nikko Europe Plc, the European investment banking arm of Nikko Securities Co Ltd, said on Tuesday it had appointed Simon Briscoe managing director and joint head of a new integrated research division.

Briscoe was formerly Nikko's UK economist and head of fixed income research. The new unit combines equity, fixed income, and credit research areas. Larry Prager, currently managing director of equity research will become the other joint head, a company statement said.
Philip Busfield becomes managing director and joint head of fixed income and money markets trading with Kenji Yoshibayashi.
